description: This Java class 'PolicyCommandFactory' provides factory methods for creating commands related to retrieving policies, specifically focusing on 'sudo' retrieve policies with optional cache lookup contexts and managing correlation IDs.

classes.name: PolicyCommandFactory
classes.description: Utility class for creating commands to access policy services, specifically for sudo retrieve commands with optional cache lookup context.

methods.name: sudoRetrievePolicy
methods.description: Creates a sudo retrieve policy command based on an EntityId and optional cache lookup context.

methods.name: sudoRetrievePolicy
methods.description: Creates a sudo retrieve policy command based on a PolicyId and optional cache lookup context.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a correlation ID for logging purposes, using UUID when no ID is available, and logs the event.
